concepts.name: LEGACY: Archived, superseded by ORISO-Helm
concepts.summary: This repository is ARCHIVED upstream (Neusta-owned, read-only) with no commits since 2026-07-09. The canonical, actively maintained deployment repository is ORISO-Helm. Treat everything here as historical reference for analysis only — never deploy from or modify this repo.

concepts.name: Platform Deployment Configuration (historical)
concepts.summary: Historical Kubernetes deployment configuration for the whole ORISO platform: infrastructure (MariaDB, MongoDB, RabbitMQ, Redis), Keycloak, backend services (Tenant, User, Agency, ConsultingType, Upload), frontend & admin, communication (Matrix Synapse, Element, LiveKit), and monitoring (SigNoz, Health Dashboard). Superseded by ORISO-Helm; last change wired the LiveKit token service websocket URL.

concepts.name: ConfigMaps, Helm & Ingress
concepts.summary: The repo groups its manifests into configmaps/ (captured live service configuration snapshots), helm/ (umbrella chart oriso-platform plus per-service charts) and ingress/ (numbered host/TLS routing manifests applied via apply-ingress.sh), with docs/ holding the multitenancy specification.
